card.name: Spacing inside dose and time lists
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas, hyphens, and "and" that sit right after a first number in a list or range of doses or times, just before the next number and a unit like mg or hours.

modes.label: Dose ranges and lists
modes.description: Separator after a first dose number in animal or trial dose lists, before the next dose and mg/kg.

modes.label: Time-point lists
modes.description: Comma or space after a first time number in a list of hours or minutes.
modes.example: when taken at 1<<,>> 4 and 8 hours after v

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space just before a number following "at" or "approximately".
modes.example: Increases in BP peak approximately<< >>40 minutes after SPRAVATO
